categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Touches only standalone developer tooling under contrib/devtools, with no changes to the build system, dependencies, Guix, or CI.
categories.rationale: Not a member of Build and CI; developer helper scripts belong in Tools and scripts.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Has the Scripts and tools label and modifies contrib/devtools/deterministic-fuzz-coverage.
categories.rationale: Adds selective coverage checks to avoid time-consuming execution during debugging. As the description notes, running both individual and combined checks 'can be very time-consuming when debugging a specific determinism failure or cross-input state leak', offering clear developer workflow improvements for fuzzing contributors.
